behave.en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
behave.zh: 其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。

bite.en: If you bite me, I'll bite you back.
bite.zh: 如果你咬我，我就咬回来。

bill.en: The bill was passed after a hard fight in the House.
bill.zh: 该法案在众议院争议后获得通过。

beg.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？

blame.en: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
blame.zh: 我们都不认为他是事故的罪魁祸首。

bee.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
bee.zh: 蜜蜂螫人可以是非常痛苦的。

being.en: For the time being, I'm studying French at this language school.
being.zh: 目前，我正在这所语言学校学习法语。

bath.en: I was having a bath when the telephone rang.
bath.zh: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

broken.en: They accused me of having broken my promise.
broken.zh: 他们指责我没有信守诺言。

battle.en: This is the place where the battle of Hastings took place.
battle.zh: 这里是黑斯廷斯战役发生的地方。

born.en: I live in Boston, but I was born in Chicago.
born.zh: 我住在波士顿，但我出生在芝加哥。

bachelor.en: Tom remained a bachelor until his death.

bicycle.en: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
bicycle.zh: 你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？

baggage.en: How many pieces of baggage do you have?

business.en: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
business.zh: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。

butter.en: I like to eat honey and peanut butter sandwiches.
butter.zh: 我喜欢吃蜂蜜花生酱三明治。

beginning.en: I hope that this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
beginning.zh: 希望这是美好友谊的开始。

balcony.en: The family is eating breakfast on the balcony.
balcony.zh: 一家人在阳台上吃早饭。

brave.en: His brave deed earned him respect.
brave.zh: 他的英勇行为使他赢得了尊重。

breath.en: After running up the hill, I was completely out of breath.
breath.zh: 跑上山后，我完全喘不过气来。

bench.en: Tom and I sat on a bench in the park and talked while we fed pigeons.
bench.zh: 我和汤姆在公园的长椅上坐着，一边聊天一边喂着鸽子。

bargain.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
bargain.zh: 这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。

baseball.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
baseball.zh: 他喜欢看电视上的棒球比赛。

button.en: All you have to do is push this button to take a picture.
button.zh: 你要做的就是按这个按钮拍照。

blood.en: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
blood.zh: 科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

bound.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.

barely.en: Tom can barely afford to pay rent let alone buy a PC.
barely.zh: 汤姆连房租都快付不起，更别说买一台电脑了。

beginner.en: Tom's a beginner, but he catches on fast.
beginner.zh: 汤姆是个初学者，但他赶上得很快。

beauty.en: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
beauty.zh: 瑞士以它的风景优美而闻名。

burst.en: The water pipes froze and then burst.

bathroom.en: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.
bathroom.zh: 我有时会听到父亲在浴室里唱歌。

belt.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
belt.zh: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

biology.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
biology.zh: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。

beach.en: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
beach.zh: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。

blind.en: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
blind.zh: 善良是聋子能听盲人能看的语言。

bloom.en: This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.

bowl.en: The dog is sitting by the bowl.

belong.en: Iceland used to belong to Denmark.

boss.en: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
boss.zh: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。

butterfly.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.

bankrupt.en: The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.

bet.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.

basic.en: Mathematics is basic to all sciences.
basic.zh: 数学是所有科学的基础。

blanket.en: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
blanket.zh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？

backward.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
backward.zh: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。

breathe.en: I want to breathe some fresh air.
breathe.zh: 我想呼吸一下新鲜空气。

boil.en: I'll boil the potatoes for you.

bush.en: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
bush.zh: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。

bend.en: I can't bend my right arm.
bend.zh: 我无法弯曲我的右手臂。

beard.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
beard.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

bucket.en: Please fill this bucket with water.

board.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
board.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

border.en: I was asked to show my passport at the border.
border.zh: 在边境上，我被要求出示我的护照。

birth.en: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
birth.zh: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

bark.en: A dog will bark at strangers.

brilliant.en: A brilliant future lay before him.
brilliant.zh: 大好的前途摆在他面前。

betray.en: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.
betray.zh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。

badly.en: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
badly.zh: 当她的孩子在公共场合行为表现不好的时候，她觉得很尴尬。

buddhism.en: Buddhism had its beginnings in India.

branch.en: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
branch.zh: 新的分店下个月在芝加哥开始营业。

bullet.en: I don't see any bullet holes.

behavior.en: Some people felt that Tom's behavior was inappropriate.
behavior.zh: 一部分人感觉Tom的行为举止不太合适。

burn.en: When you've finished reading this letter, burn it.
burn.zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。

bow.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
bow.zh: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

blast.en: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
blast.zh: 收音机广播充斥著有关最近爆炸的新闻。

barber.en: A barber is a man who shaves and cuts men's hair.
barber.zh: 理发师是为男人刮胡子和剪头发的人。

balance.en: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
balance.zh: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。

burglar.en: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
burglar.zh: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

barley.en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
barley.zh: 你能辨别小麦和大麦吗？

behalf.en: He is acting on his own behalf.

blink.en: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
blink.zh: 人平均一分钟眨几次眼睛？

bud.en: The trees are beginning to bud.

brain.zh: 他是一个优秀的脑外科医生。

background.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
background.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

base.en: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
base.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

bacon.en: Would you like bacon or sausage?

blouse.en: Mary bought a shirt and a blouse.
blouse.zh: 玛丽买了一件衬衫和一件女式衬衫。

bottom.en: She is always at the bottom of the class.
bottom.zh: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。

bluntly.en: To put it bluntly, he's mistaken.

bald.en: He started going bald quite young.
bald.zh: 他很年轻就开始秃头了。

band.en: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
band.zh: 很难找到一位没有在其他乐团工作的优秀主唱。

besides.en: Besides the piano, can you play any other instruments?
besides.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

bunch.en: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.
bunch.zh: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。

budget.en: We are traveling on a tight budget.

brandy.en: She poured brandy into the glasses.
brandy.zh: 她把白兰地倒进玻璃杯里。

balloon.en: The balloon was caught in the tree.

broadcast.en: That program is now being broadcast.
broadcast.zh: 那个节目现在正在播出。

booth.en: Tom ran and ran, until at last he saw the telephone booth.
booth.zh: 汤姆跑啊跑, 直到他终于看到了电话亭。

beyond.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
beyond.zh: 你看过富士山吗? 它美得无法形容。

bamboo.en: There's bamboo growing in the garden.

bomb.en: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
bomb.zh: 在伦敦，警察总是担心在列车或地铁上发现炸弹。

bleach.en: Don't mix ammonia and bleach together.
bleach.zh: 别把氨水和漂白剂混在一起。

bribe.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.

belief.en: It's my belief that knowledge is power.

bar.en: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.
bar.zh: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。

brass.en: A brass band is marching along the street.
brass.zh: 一个管弦乐团沿着路前进

brook.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

bug.en: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
bug.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

blend.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.

basis.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
basis.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

bible.en: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
bible.zh: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

bitterness.en: He couldn't stand the bitterness of the coffee.

ban.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
ban.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。

bandage.en: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
bandage.zh: 他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。

bare.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
bare.zh: 空手赤拳抓野兔并不容易。

basement.en: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
basement.zh: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

bay.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
bay.zh: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。

bait.en: Before he went fishing, he dug up some worms for bait.
bait.zh: 出去钓鱼前，他挖出一些虫子当饵。

beforehand.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
beforehand.zh: 万一来不了，我会先给你打电话。

billion.en: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
billion.zh: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。
